description: This file defines a simple data transfer object (DTO) class LoginRequest, which encapsulates email and password fields with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: A DTO class that contains login credentials (email and password) with accessor and mutator methods.

methods.name: getEmail
methods.description: Returns the email address used for login.

methods.name: setEmail
methods.description: Sets the email address for login.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password used for login.
